title: Golden Delight Toast Thai Omelette
description: A Thai-inspired omelette made with golden delight, spinach, and served on toasted bread.
instructions: 1. Crack 2 eggs into a bowl and whisk them together. Add 1/4 cup of Golden Delight and mix well.
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
3. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook until the eggs start to set.
4. Add 1 cup of chopped spinach to one half of the omelette and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
5. Fold the other half of the omelette over the spinach.
6. Cook for another 2-3 minutes and serve on toasted bread.
7. Garnish with additional Golden Delight if desired.
